Summary: According to the sources, DRAGIN (Dynamic Retrieval Augmented Generation based on the Information Needs of Large Language Models) achieved superior performance across all tested datasets and LLM variants, including LLaMA-2-Chat 7B/13B and Vicuna-13B-v1.5. Specifically, DRAGIN outperformed all baseline methods, establishing new state-of-the-art results in dynamic RAG, particularly in multi-hop reasoning tasks. The model's ability to retrieve relevant information at critical decision points proved most valuable. The exact performance metrics for DRAGIN on Vicuna-13b-v1.5 are 0.288 EM, 0.4164 F1, and 0.686.
